tape: All 14 screens ran at defaults. csp-wheel returned 20 put setups: 13 on the Nov 20 expiry, 4 on Oct 30 (NU, FSLY, SMMT, SEDG), 2 on Nov 6, 1 on Nov 13.

The screen flagged earnings UNKNOWN on all 20. TMPro's feed and Yahoo put 14 reports inside expiry (TMPro's feed confirms WULF and SLS). NU, FSLY, SEDG and APLD clear their expiry. CRML has no date anywhere; SMMT's two sources disagree.
Chart trend on the 20 CSP names: 7 downtrend, 9 mixed, 4 uptrend. FSLY (-18.5%), APLD (-13.8%), SHLS (-13.6%) and WULF (-9.0%) are the worst five-day moves.
All 20 carry a CBOE 52-week IV rank. NU is richest at 96.6; CRML is cheapest at 5.75.
Ten quotes are wide: NU, CRML, FSLY, CRSR, BSP, WRBY, SMMT, STNE, AGIO, SEDG.
One correlation cluster (60-day returns, 0.7 linkage): WULF+APLD. Gamma scan: 14 of 25 names in positive dealer gamma, 11 in negative.
